channel.title: Violations Watch: Colombia
channel.description: New incidents reported in Colombia. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Family of four, including two young children, found burned in their home on a rural farm in La Tola, Nariño, in an area under FARC-dissident control; Indepaz records it as the 110th massacre of 2026 (El Heraldo, Semana)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). La Tola (rural farm), Nariño, Colombia. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unknown; Semana says the area is controlled by the FARC-dissident Frente 30, and Indepaz notes the EMC and local gangs operate there. Reported casualties: 4 killed. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Cause and perpetrator unconfirmed; investigators had not reached the site; La Tola government secretary said no one knows who is responsible and suicide had not been ruled out. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2730

item.title: Colombian army says it recovered four adolescents forcibly recruited by FARC-dissident Estructura 33 in Tibú and El Tarra, Catatumbo, and handed them to the ICBF (Radio Santa Fe, Minuto30, Diario La Libertad)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tibú and El Tarra, Catatumbo, Norte de Santander, Colombia. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Estructura 33 FARC dissidents (per the Colombian army and the minors' own accounts). Grave violations against children: Recruitment and use. Disputed or caveats: Account comes from the army and the President (a party to the conflict); Radio Santa Fe's headline says 3 but its text says 4; date of recruitment not stated. 3 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2733

item.title: Car bomb outside the Meta Governor's Office in Villavicencio, Colombia, injures more than 20 people and damages buildings; President blames ex-FARC dissidents
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Villavicencio, Colombia. Types: Killing of civilians, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Ex-FARC dissidents (according to the president). Reported casualties: 20-23 injured. Disputed or caveats: Attribution to ex-FARC dissidents by President; no claim reported. 6 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2033

item.title: Drone attack on a police facility in Cúcuta injures three civilians, including an infant, and damages homes (Al Jazeera, AP)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Cúcuta, Norte de Santander, Colombia. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed group. Reported casualties: 3 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. 6 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1912
